ChatTurnRequest.description:
`POST /v1/chat/turns`: exactly four members; no index, key, deployment, model, prompt,
option or history is accepted from the caller.
ChatTurnRequest.title: ChatTurnRequest

Citation.description:
The one public citation shape: the `citations` event, replays and session reads alike.
It never carries a document, version, chunk-set or index identifier, a chunk key or a path.
Citation.title: Citation

CitationContentType.description: The MIME type of a cited file.
CitationContentType.title: CitationContentType

CitationDetail.description:
What the citation viewer needs: the citation as `Citation` shows it and the two file
names, which cross-origin scripts can't read from `Content-Disposition`.
CitationDetail.title: CitationDetail

ContentType.description: The three media types a version can have (`CK_document_versions_content_type`).
ContentType.title: ContentType

CurrentUserFeatures.description:
The ops-config switches the web client reads: `memory.enabled` and
`feedback.comments_enabled`.
CurrentUserFeatures.title: CurrentUserFeatures

DocumentRef.description: A document and its source name (`11-api.md` section 4.3).
DocumentRef.title: DocumentRef

DocumentReingestStarted.description:
`runId` is the new run (`202`) or the newest open run that already holds an item for
the current version and target (`200`); `itemCount` 1 or 0 accordingly.
DocumentReingestStarted.title: DocumentReingestStarted

FactCategory.description: What a remembered fact is about.
FactCategory.title: FactCategory

FactSource.description: Where a fact came from: the session of an extracted fact; `null` for the user's own.
FactSource.title: FactSource

FeedbackRequest.description: The whole feedback value: a `PUT` replaces what is stored.
FeedbackRequest.title: FeedbackRequest

FeedbackView.description: Stored feedback as the client sees it: no `createdAt`.
FeedbackView.title: FeedbackView

FieldError.description: One failed field of a `422`: where, and why; never the input value.
FieldError.title: FieldError

IndexRunStarted.description: `adminCreateIndex` and `adminDeleteIndex`: the index and the run the operation created.
IndexRunStarted.title: IndexRunStarted

IndexUpdate.description:
Every field of `IndexCreate`, each optional; `description` also takes `null`, which
clears it.
IndexUpdate.title: IndexUpdate

MemoryView.description:
The caller's memory as every memory operation answers it; `etag` is the `If-Match` value
of the next write.
MemoryView.title: MemoryView

PreflightRejection.description: Why preflight rejects a file (the `reason` of a `rejected` result).
PreflightRejection.title: PreflightRejection

PreflightStatus.description: A file's status in `adminPreflightUploads` (`14-ingestion.md` section 2.3 item 4).
PreflightStatus.title: PreflightStatus

Problem.description:
The one body of every non-`2xx` answer. The optional members are absent, never `null`,
when they don't apply, which the schema states by leaving `null` out of their types.
Problem.title: Problem

ProjectRef.description: A project and its name (`11-api.md` section 4.3).
ProjectRef.title: ProjectRef

ProjectUpdate.description:
`adminUpdateProject`'s body: at least one field; an absent field stays unchanged, and no
field may be null.
ProjectUpdate.title: ProjectUpdate

ReingestRequest.description:
The body of `adminStartReingest` and `adminReingestDocument`: exactly `{}`, required and
holding no member (section 1.7).
ReingestRequest.title: ReingestRequest

SubmitOutcome.description: Each requested version's outcome in `adminSubmitUploads` (section 2.6 step 2.3).
SubmitOutcome.title: SubmitOutcome

TurnStatus.description: A turn is created `streaming` and moves to exactly one terminal status.
TurnStatus.title: TurnStatus

TurnUsageSummary.description:
The turn's token totals as the client sees them: no cost, deployment or per-call
record.
TurnUsageSummary.title: TurnUsageSummary

TurnView.description: What a stored turn shows: exactly these 13 keys.
TurnView.title: TurnView

UploadPreflightResult.description: One file's status; `name` is the name after NFC and trimming.
UploadPreflightResult.title: UploadPreflightResult

UserRef.description: A person; `displayName` is `""` when no `app.users` row exists for the ID.
UserRef.title: UserRef
